g.text: Greetings, Drifter darling. I have come to settle our contract. You struck a bargain with me to ensure that you could not fail in garnering my affection.
Greetings, Drifter. I have come to settle our contract. You struck a bargain with me to ensure that you could not fail in garnering Marie's affection.
Greetings, Drifter. I have come to settle our contract. You struck a bargain with me to ensure that you could not fail in garnering Lyon's affection.

Greetings, Drifter. I have come to settle our contract. You struck a bargain with me to ensure that you could not fail in convincing Marie that Albrecht was not as infallible as she believed him to be.
Greetings, Drifter. I have come to settle our contract. You struck a bargain with me to ensure that you could not fail in traversing through the poor priest's tales of woe?
Greetings, Drifter. I have come to settle our contract. You struck a bargain with me to ensure that the scrawny butler would go upstairs, one way or another.
Greetings, Drifter. I have come to settle our contract. You struck a bargain with me to ensure that the scrawny butler would go upstairs, one way or another.
Greetings, Drifter. I have come to settle our contract. You struck a bargain with me to ensure that the scrawny butler would go upstairs, one way or another.
Greetings, Drifter. I have come to settle our contract. You struck a bargain with me to ensure that the scrawny butler would go upstairs, one way or another.
Greetings, Drifter. I have come to settle our contract. You struck a bargain with me to ensure that the scrawny butler would go upstairs, one way or another.
Greetings, Drifter. I have come to settle our contract. You struck a bargain with me to ensure that the scrawny butler would go upstairs, one way or another.
Greetings, Drifter. I have come to settle our contract. You struck a bargain with me to ensure that the scrawny butler would go upstairs, one way or another.
Are you content with how you left things with her? Or would you like me to prod her into another conversation with you?
Are you content with how you left things with him? Or would you like me to prod him into another conversation with you?
Which you correctly predicted you would need. As you have been quite the belligerent pain in my arse.
And, as you predicted you might, you painted yourself into a corner with your chosen prey; Marie. Haven't you? No matter. The devil is here to save you, per our contract.

And, as you predicted you might, you painted yourself into a corner with your chosen prey; Lyon. (Though I honestly do not know how you managed it.) No matter. The devil is here to save you, per our contract.
Can we skip past the lectures?
You aren't exactly the easiest person to navigate speaking to.
When you say it like that, this all sounds disgusting.
When you say it like that, this all sounds disgusting.
It seems you have entirely botched it, haven't you? My oh my, this is quite laughable. Well, I can ensure that you have my cooperation, as reticent as it may be.
How have you managed to bungle it with the both of them?! Very well. No point in whining about it now, I suppose.
You have managed to bungle it up with both myself and Marie. Fantastic. Well, I can ensure that you have my cooperation, as reticent as it may be.
You have managed to bungle it up with both myself and Lyon. Fantastic. Well, I can ensure that you have my cooperation, as reticent as it may be.
It seems I am the only remaining holdout? Well, that makes things simple enough. I can ensure that you have my cooperation, as reticent as it may be.
It seems Marie is the remaining holdout.
It seems Lyon is the remaining holdout.
Contractually I am required to forgive you, but it says nothing about leaving your face attached to your skull. So I would council that you watch your words as we go forward.
Contractually I am required to forgive you, so I am not certain why you are bothering to apologize, but I appreciate it regardless.

I am not the one who made the contract in the first place! And if you are considering backing out of it now, know that I will still expect you to hold up your end in the future, regardless of if I complete mine.

I am not the one who made the contract in the first place! And if you are considering backing out of it now, know that I will still expect you to hold up your end in the future, regardless of if I complete mine.
But there is only so much strong-arming I can do with the other two. Understand that I can only do so much. Clearing the way and doing the work are two different things.
There is only so much strong-arming I can do in this regard. Clearing the way and doing the work are two different things.
There is only so much strong-arming I can do in this regard. Clearing the way and doing the work are two different things.
I wish you the best of luck. You will only have this one attempt.
I wish you the best of luck. You will only have this one attempt.
But as you wish, we will... hurry this along. I would be remiss if I did not ask if this is something you still wished to move forward with?
So you might as well collect.
Consider it done. I shall see what I can do to quicken matters betwixt you. But after that, it is up to you to seal the deal, as it were. I cannot hold your hands the entire way.
Consider it done. I shall see what I can do to quicken matters betwixt you. But after that, it is up to you to seal the deal, as it were. I cannot hold your hands the entire way.
So you might as well collect.
We will have to do this one at a time. Let us begin with the more logical-minded of the two. The priest.
I wish you the best of luck. You will only have this one attempt with her.
I wish you the best of luck. You will only have this one attempt with him.
As I was saying, any other individual with a less pursuivant view on life might find your own... entrepreneurial behavior in a less than favorable light.
No. I can't. I change my mind.
Well. I could. But that is an entirely different conversation. Simply remember that the devil always collects his due.
Well. I could. But that is an entirely different conversation. Simply remember that the devil always collects his due.
No. I can't. I change my mind.
But there is only so much strong-arming I can do with the other two. Understand that I can only do so much. Clearing the way and doing the work are two different things.
But there is only so much strong-arming I can do with Marie. Clearing the way and doing the work are two different things.
But there is only so much strong-arming I can do with Lyon. Clearing the way and doing the work are two different things.

But I find myself rather amused by your decision to bargain with me for my own affections. So, here we are. But I would be remiss if I did not ask if this is something you still wished to move forward with?
I think you're bluffing. I don't even think you have a plan for what you want.
Which is what, exactly? You never said what you wanted out of this contract.
I think you're bluffing. I don't even think you have a plan for what you want.
Which is what, exactly? You never said what you wanted out of this contract.
We will have to do this one at a time. Let us begin with the more logical-minded of the two. The priest.
I wish you the best of luck. You will only have this one attempt.
I wish you the best of luck. You will only have this one attempt.
What a remarkably odd little creature you are. Come speak to me if you change your mind.
The "what" is not nearly as important as the "who," Usurper.
You do realize how powerful you are, yes? And how important having you in my pocket could be?
The "what" is not nearly as important as the "who," Usurper.
You do realize how powerful you are, yes? And how important having you in my pocket could be?
You still owe me my end of the contract, whether or not you wish me to make good upon your end of it.
This is what is called a "blank cheque" in olden terms I believe? And you signed it quite willingly.
This is what is called a "blank cheque" in olden terms I believe? And you signed it quite willingly.
And the devil will always collect his due.
What a remarkably odd little creature you are. Delicious, but odd, Drifter darling.
The only thing more dangerous than a devil... is a devil with friends like you who owe him. Now, if you'll excuse me? I have a floating "Sister of Sol" to annoy.
The only thing more dangerous than a devil... is a devil with friends like you who owe him. Now, if you'll excuse me? I have a mad priest to annoy.
I must ask, however. Why? Why make such an outrageous deal? Are you so curious to taste Orokin flesh after so many centuries?
I hate to sound utterly shallow and crass, but... have you looked in the mirror lately?
Roathe. You may not believe me, but I... I love you.
You may not believe me, but I care about you.
I am certain there is a degree of something unfeigned to what you say. Or at the very least, I believe you do not know your own self-delusion.
Honesty is a wonderful thing, Drifter dear. Do you think I would shame you for enjoying yourself? Hardly.
I believe the greatest achievement of the Orokin Empire was its ability to convince those within it to believe their own conceits.
Here is to a relationship of mutual satisfaction.
But why make such an arrangement, unless...?
In fact, perhaps that is the true connective tissue of the human race: our masterful ability to look in the mirror and deceive ourselves.
I screwed it up last time. I couldn't run that risk again.
I made the deal because I was desperate to get this right.
All in the name of avoiding the terrible shame of admitting when we need to change.
You signed your soul away to the devil himself because... he unknowingly already held your broken heart.
Not that I would know anything on the topic.
I am a bit of an expert on the subject, as you well know.
Forgive me. Please, forgive me. I did not know.
You must also understand that, until now, my love was a commodity that no one had sought to claim. Not in any meaningful way.
So you seemed willing to sell your soul for a single bit of salvage. You can imagine my confusion. How baffled I was.
Now? Now that I know the truth? Drifter, my Drifter... I could not be more glad that you did.
For I cannot wait to see what we might together wreak upon this Origin System... and countless others.
For together, what we are capable of boggles the mind, doesn't it?
